fixtures.name: tests/conftest.py::_chdb_connections_closed_after_module
fixtures.rationale: Closes chDB connections left open by a test module so embedded-engine state cannot accumulate across modules; the open counter keeps its cost to a counter read per module.

fixtures.name: tests/utilities/module_state_guard.py::_process_state_unchanged_after_module
fixtures.rationale: Fails the module that leaves a benchbox logger, the quiet flag or the tracer provider changed, because a module-scoped fixture's change runs before the per-test restore and leaks into later modules in the same worker; it is an in-memory compare costing under a millisecond per module.
